_comment: Canonical design tokens. Repo-owned and implementation-neutral: design tools (Figma, Penpot, code-first) DERIVE from this file; they are never the canonical source (see docs/NATIVE-BASELINE-AND-ENRICHMENT.md, Design tool independence). Names are semantic concepts, never tool-internal structure.

color._comment: Aubergine house palette per 0.1 Figma export + design/handoff/DESIGN_TOKENS.json (the operator decision 2026-09-06: most recent Figma export is canonical). Matches DESIGN-HANDOFF §J declared house palette.

status_vocabulary._comment: Rank/scale encoded by luminance only, never hue (owner accessibility rule). These words are the signal; color is reinforcement only.

targets._comment: All interactive targets >= 44x44 CSS pixels (WCAG 2.5.5 + Apple HIG).

motion._comment: Animation off by default; respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

focus._comment: Comfortable: accent.primary (#72b1b1 teal) per ACCESSIBILITY_CONTRACT.md §2.4; high contrast: white. outline-offset (2px) is set separately in frontend/src/index.css's :focus-visible rule, not duplicated here. Fixed 2026-09-11 (UI-convergence session): the previous value ('2px solid accent.primary, offset 2px') was an unresolved token reference plus invalid outline shorthand syntax — the browser silently discarded the whole `outline` declaration as invalid, so every keyboard focus ring in the app was invisible (initial outline-style is `none`). tokens:check only diffs generated-vs-committed CSS, so it never caught this; confirmed live via keyboard tab-through + getComputedStyle in a running browser.

typography._comment_fonts: Figma-export families (0.1). Repo ships system-ui until self-hosted webfonts are added; expressive/interface names are the design intent, not a runtime requirement.
